      The road closures in Coventry you need to know about this week as schools go back

      There are across the city

      Listen to audio version of this article
      Sponsored by
      0:00 / 3:23
      Instaread
      News
      Claire Harrison
      05:45, 31 Aug 2026

      All of the planned road closures across Coventry this week have been listed.

      It comes as many families gear up for the return to school after the summer holidays..

      The closures are contained in the latest temporary traffic order rubber-stamped by the city council for a variety of different road works.

      READ MORE: Anger over children 'chucking eggs' at cars in these Coventry streets

      ‌

      READ MORE: New Coventry code of conduct to control this specific type of activity in city centre

      CoventryLive has compiled a list of the latest closures below:

      George Eliot Road, Coventry

      George Eliot Road will be from its junction with Foleshill Road for approximately 30 metres.

      ‌

      It comes into force at 7am on Tuesday, September 1 for new gas connection and services and associated works

      It is expected that the works will be completed by Tuesday, September 15.

      Binley Road, Coventry

      Binley Road will be closed at its junction with Bulls Head Lane and continuing to its junction with Biggin Hall Crescent.

      ‌

      It comes into force from just after midnight on Monday, September 7 for Severn Trent Water to renew a frame and cover works.

      The works are due to be finished by Tuesday, September 8.

      Greyfriars Lane, Coven

      It will be closed from just midnight on Tuesday, September 8 for Severn Trent Water to safely repair a leaking water pipe.

      ‌
      • Greyfriars Lane from its junction with Salt Lane to its junction with High Street.
      • Suspension of one way on the High street between its junctions with Greyfriars Lane and Hay Lane.
      • Suspension of taxi parking bays along Greyfriars Lane from its junction with Salt Lane to its junction with High Street.

      The works are set to be complete by Thursday, September 10.

      Allesley Old Road side roads, Coventry

      The closure comes into force just after midnight on Tuesday, September 1 for Cadent Gas to safely renew gas mains.

      ‌

      It is expected that the works would be completed by Sunday, September 28.

      • Duke street - Commencing at its junction with Allesley Old Road and then southbound for Approximately 30m
      • Lord Street - Commencing at its junction with Allesley Old Road and then southbound for approximately 30m
      • Mount Street - Commencing at its junction with Allesley Old Road and then southbound for approximately 30m
      • St Thomas Whites Road - Commencing at its junction with Allesley Old Road and then southbound for approximately 30m

      Britannia Street, Coventry

      Britannia Street will be closed at its junction with Paynes Lane and continuing to its junction with Grantham Street.

      ‌

      It comes into force at just after midnight on Saturday, September 5 for excavation works for 2 HV electric ducts..

      It is expected that the works will be finished by Wednesday, September 16,

      In all of the closures, local access will be maintained as well as for emergency services.
